name: Client Proposal
description: A structured commercial proposal for new or existing clients

required_sections.title: Cover Page
required_sections.description: Company logo, client name, proposal title, date

required_sections.title: Executive Summary
required_sections.description: 2–3 paragraph overview of the opportunity and proposed solution

required_sections.title: Understanding Your Situation
required_sections.description: Client's challenge or goal as we understand it

required_sections.title: Our Solution
required_sections.description: Description of the proposed approach and deliverables

required_sections.title: Scope of Work
required_sections.description: Itemised list of in-scope and out-of-scope activities

required_sections.title: Terms & Conditions
required_sections.description: Standard payment, liability, and IP terms

optional_sections.title: Relevant Experience
optional_sections.include_when: case studies are available in context library

optional_sections.title: Our Team
optional_sections.include_when: client has requested team info or team_bios are populated
